## Pass Criteria

- all required builds, flashes, and Micro-ESPectre deployments complete successfully
- Native Lightweight, Native High Accuracy, Micro-ESPectre Lightweight, Micro-ESPectre High Accuracy, ESPHome Lightweight, and ESPHome High Accuracy runtime benchmarks log shared debug telemetry throughout the runtime window
- non-runtime benchmarks log at least 5 shared debug telemetry samples
- free heap does not decline by more than 5% after startup has settled
- Native Lightweight, Native High Accuracy, Micro-ESPectre Lightweight, Micro-ESPectre High Accuracy, ESPHome Lightweight, and ESPHome High Accuracy runtime benchmarks log detector status once per second after the first detector status line
- Native Lightweight, Native High Accuracy, Micro-ESPectre Lightweight, Micro-ESPectre High Accuracy, ESPHome Lightweight, and ESPHome High Accuracy runtime benchmarks log CSI occupancy on detector status lines
- Native Lightweight, Native High Accuracy, Micro-ESPectre Lightweight, Micro-ESPectre High Accuracy, ESPHome Lightweight, and ESPHome High Accuracy mean CSI occupancy stays at or above the 70% admitted-slot detector-ready floor
- Native Lightweight, Native High Accuracy, Micro-ESPectre Lightweight, Micro-ESPectre High Accuracy, ESPHome Lightweight, and ESPHome High Accuracy detector timing is present
- Matter smoke benchmarks log a boot marker and the commissioning startup state
- Streamer benchmarks log the device IP and reach STREAMING
- Streamer host collect logs at least 60 Lightweight and High Accuracy samples
- Streamer host collect mean CSI occupancy stays at or above the 70% admitted-slot detector-ready floor
- no fatal firmware log is observed
